name: step-guide-maker
description: Turn a folder of screenshots into a step-by-step guide: numbered steps with titles and text, highlight boxes, pixelated private details and crops, exported as a self-contained HTML page, Markdown with images, and a PDF. Write the steps in a simple Markdown file next to the screenshots (`## title`, text, and optional `框:` / `打码:` / `裁剪:` lines in percent), or fill them in per row. When a step has no box, it can draw one automatically around what changed since the previous screenshot. Checks duplicate screenshots, steps text that doesn't match the number of screenshots, steps without a title, boxes outside the image, login screens with nothing blurred and tiny screenshots. Runs locally; no account or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把一文件夹截图做成图文步骤教程：带编号的步骤标题和说明、高亮框、敏感信息马赛克、裁剪，导出为单文件 HTML 网页、Markdown（附图片）和 PDF。步骤可以写在截图旁边的 Markdown 文件里（`## 标题`、说明，以及可选的 `框:` / `打码:` / `裁剪:` 百分比坐标），也可以逐行填写。没有写框的步骤，可以自动框出和上一张截图相比变化的区域。会检查重复截图、步骤数和截图数对不上、没有标题的步骤、超出图片的框、没打码的登录页面和太小的截图。在本地运行，不用登录，无需 API 密钥。
